title: Trade button shown disabled with a reason when no broker is connected (G-02-3)

ours: NEW AC NEEDED: we prompt only when the action is used (REQ-015 AC-1, AC-2 owner wording kept); add a visible disabled-state hint on Execute when there is no session. Built in 172f1f18 (AC-10).
